widget.name: Native Search Select
widget.description: Select with a searchable option list, over an enumeration or a list of objects

property.caption: Options from
property.description: Where the options come from. Enumeration reads them from the bound attribute itself, so nothing else needs modelling. Objects reads them from a data source and writes the chosen object to an association.

property.caption: Value
property.description: Enumeration attribute holding the selection. The options and their captions come from the enumeration itself, in the language of the session. Required when Options from is Enumeration.

property.caption: Options
property.description: List of objects to choose from. Required when Options from is Objects. The whole list is retrieved and searched on the device, so keep it to a size that is reasonable to hold in memory.

property.caption: Selected
property.description: Association the chosen object is written to. Required when Options from is Objects.

property.caption: Option caption
property.description: Text shown for each object, in the list and in the closed field. Ignored when Options from is Enumeration.

property.caption: Option subtitle
property.description: Optional second line under each option, for a code, a location or any other detail that tells two similar captions apart. It is searched along with the caption. Ignored when Options from is Enumeration.

property.caption: Extra search text
property.description: Further text matched against the search query but never shown, such as a synonym or an abbreviation. Ignored when Options from is Enumeration.

property.caption: Placeholder
property.description: Shown in the closed field while nothing is selected

property.caption: Dropdown icon
property.description: Trailing icon on the closed field. Left unset, the widget draws the same chevron the platform's own Drop-down does.

property.caption: Allow clear
property.description: Add a row at the top of the list that empties the selection. Leave off for a required value.

property.caption: Clear caption
property.description: Caption of the clearing row. Falls back to the placeholder. Requires Allow clear.

property.caption: Search placeholder
property.description: Hint shown in the empty search box

property.caption: Minimum options for search
property.description: Hide the search box until there are at least this many options, so a short list opens straight to its choices. 0 always shows it.

property.caption: Match
property.description: How a typed query is matched. Accents and letter case are ignored in every mode, so a query of "plantacion" finds "Plantación".

property.caption: Focus search on open
property.description: Raise the keyboard as soon as the list opens. Turn off to show the full list first.

property.caption: Search icon
property.description: Leading icon inside the search box. Left unset, a magnifier from the app's icon font is drawn.

property.caption: Order
property.description: How the options are ordered. As modelled keeps an enumeration's own order, or a data source's sort order, which is where to sort objects on something other than their caption. The two caption orders ignore accents and letter case, so Ópalo sorts under O and not after Z.

property.caption: Title
property.description: Heading above the search box

property.caption: No results caption
property.description: Shown in place of the list when nothing matches the query

property.caption: Close icon
property.description: Icon that closes the list without choosing. Left unset, a cross from the app's icon font is drawn.

property.caption: Selected icon
property.description: Icon marking the option currently selected. Left unset, a check mark from the app's icon font is drawn.

property.caption: On open
property.description: Runs when the list opens, before anything is chosen. Use it to refresh the options.

property.caption: On change
property.description: Runs after a new selection has been written, and after the selection is cleared

property.caption: On close
property.description: Runs when the list closes, whether or not anything was chosen
